name: Space weather
summary: Geomagnetic storm eased to quiet levels; no radiation or radio storms
state: NOAA's scales reached G2 (moderate) geomagnetic storm levels in the 24 hours to 1 Nov but were at G0 S0 R0 at 11:40 UTC on 1 Nov. No storm above G0 is forecast over the next three days.
for_you: No significant space-weather effects are expected. Minor G1 storms can bring aurora to northern Scotland.
why: Severe solar storms can disrupt satellites, GPS, HF radio and power grids.
drivers: Solar flares and coronal mass ejections; solar cycle 25 is near its peak.
